title: Strongly convex noisy value optimization with Schatten-Lipschitz Hessians and no curvature upper bound
summary: Schatten-Lipschitz Hessians under independent Gaussian scalar observations, with no upper curvature bound. Frobenius and scalar asymptotics are matched; general Schatten regimes retain explicit dimension gaps. An independent normalized operator hard subclass closes its own eventual window and supplies a finite-budget lower bound.

description_paragraphs: Minimize a hidden strongly convex objective globally on $\mathbb R^d$ using noisy scalar values, with terminal objective error as the loss.
task.formulation: Minimize a hidden strongly convex objective globally on $\mathbb R^d$ using noisy scalar values, with terminal objective error as the loss.

description_paragraphs:
For $p\in[2,\infty]$, $f:\mathbb R^d	o\mathbb R$ is $C^2$ and satisfies $$
abla^2 f(x)\succeq\mu I,\qquad\|
abla^2f(x)-
abla^2f(y)\|_{S_p}\leho\|x-y\|_2$$ for every $x,y\in\mathbb R^d$. The unique global minimizer obeys $\|x_*\|_2\le R$.

The Schatten norm $\|A\|_{S_p}$ is the ell-p norm of the singular values, with $S_2$ the Frobenius norm and $S_\infty$ the operator norm. There is no global upper bound on the Hessian or gradient. The known minimizer ball does not constrain queries or output.
